Prepared by: LitOS/LitGroup  ·  Date: November 10, 2026

You want to move MarbleWarehouse.com from Shift4Shop to Shopify. This document gives you two options: rebuild the store you have today with a set of improvements, or redesign the homepage, collection page and product page first. It also covers your data and Google rankings, the timeline, the cost and what happens after launch.

TodayYour mobile menu: orange bar and a plain list. On Shopify the mobile header gets a search field and a menu that opens each category to its sub-collections.

4

Your data, customers and Google rankings

LitExtension moves your products, categories, customers and orders from Shift4Shop to Shopify. LitExtension quotes the migration directly, based on your data volume.

Your concernHow it's handled
Google rankingsLitExtension's 301 redirect option sends every old product and category URL to its new page. It's a paid option when you buy the migration; we recommend it, otherwise these redirects are made by hand. For pages, blog posts, SEO titles and the new sitemap, we give you a step-by-step guide. Some movement in rankings in the first weeks is normal.
Orders during the moveYour current site stays live until you switch the domain. Just before launch, LitExtension moves the orders, customers and products added in the meantime.
Wrong or missing dataWe check the migrated data in the admin and on the storefront, and work with LitExtension to correct anything that's wrong or missing.
Customer loginsPasswords can't be moved to Shopify. Customers sign in with their email and a one-time code, with no password reset.

6

Open questions

#QuestionWhy it matters
1Do any products sell by the box rather than per sq ft?If yes, a sq ft ↔ box calculator (§2.10) is worth adding. Quoted separately.
2How do customers get samples today ("Need Samples?" on the product page): free, paid, or by phone only?Decides whether we add an "Order sample" button (§2.6).
3Do you want to keep your existing product reviews and testimonials?Shopify needs a review app for this; it changes what LitExtension moves and which app you install.
4How should the 50 sq ft minimum order work: per product, per order, or for all tile?Shopify has no built-in minimum per product; we'd set it up with a theme rule or an app.
5Slabs are "Available for Local Pickup Only". Do you also want shipping quotes for slabs?Pickup only is a simple Shopify setting; freight quotes need more setup.
6Do you have room or project photos of your stone for the hero and inspiration sections?The new homepage depends on them (§2.2, §2.7).
